rows.restatement: Stop when unique ideas reach at least 100 (stopping_expr unique_ideas >= 100).

rows.phrase: argue until all agree or 12 rounds
rows.restatement: Stop when all seats agree, or after 12 rounds (unanimity == true OR max_rounds == 12).

rows.phrase: 90 percent consensus with a mandatory minority report
rows.restatement: Stop when consensus is at least 90 percent. A minority report is mandatory.

rows.phrase: continue until no new counterexample for two rounds
rows.restatement: Stop after two consecutive rounds with no new counterexample (no_new_counterexample_rounds >= 2).

rows.phrase: stop only after an executable test settles it
rows.restatement: Stop only after an executable test settles it (quality_gate == PASS). No round-count OR-escape.
